open_questions: Focus runs with the same chains are near-deterministic (seeds differ only through chain picks and events); bot results are bimodal, so 8 seeds give coarse rates. QA should add real noise (see issues).

Workshops: recommend NOT raising output for share; keep 1 batch a cycle. A lane ship earns ~560 a cycle vs 540 base for a workshop batch, so workshops are a parity side-path and a sink for cash; making them dominant would hurt the spread/expand balance. Revisit only if bio stays cash-starved.

ship_cap 5 feed cost: recommend keeping 5. A lux/min full feed taking 3 of 5 ships is the intended tension (lux 88 pct to 41 pct with crafting); let the player choose raw lanes or crafting. If a human playtest finds lux crafting never worthwhile, raise ship_cap to 6, not workshop output.
